Featured Collection: Substantial Southwestern-style artisan jewelry collection featuring bold turquoise beadwork, multi-stone mosaic inlay, and coordinating silver accents.
Included Highlights:
Turquoise Statement Necklaces: Dramatic multi-strand chunky turquoise bead necklaces with barrel clasps and accent heishi bead drops displayed on stands.
Mosaic Inlay Wide Cuff Bracelet: Substantial curved wrist cuff showcasing intricate multi-stone mosaic inlay including turquoise, spiny oyster, and lapis-colored stone panels set in sterling silver.
Coordinating Rings & Earrings: Statement cabochon rings and matching turquoise dangle/drop earrings and stretch bracelets.
Materials & Finishes: Genuine turquoise, composite stones, colorful artisan mosaic inlays, and stamped .925 sterling silver settings and findings.
Condition: Pre-owned, Very Good condition. Inlaid stones and bead strands are secure and intact; cuff and ring bands are sturdy with light surface wear and authentic silver patina consistent with gentle handling.
